title: The Lost 1984 Video: young Steve Jobs introduces the Macintosh
summary: A restored recording of Steve Jobs unveiling the original Macintosh in 1984, including the moment it is taken out of its bag and speaks. The upload comes from the team that rediscovered and restored the lost footage.
why: HN commenters cite it as the source for the talking-Macintosh introduction, usually in threads about speech synthesis and audio.

quote.text: The video of Steve Jobs introducing the Macintosh in 1984 never fails to put a smile on my face.
